Make nine heads immediately countable and not overlapping: a central upright snake head, four fanning clearly on its left and four on its right. Eight mortal heads and the central immortal head; all are snake heads, no invented crowns. One continuous heavy coiled tail. Venomous open jaws and glistening dark wet scales; reed beds, black still water and mist behind. Ancient monstrous menace and poisonous horror, oppressive dawn light with restrained natural color. Entire silhouette comfortably inside frame, detailed naturalistic snake anatomy and exquisite oil brush texture. No legs, arms, wings, horns, dragon heads, dinosaur body, extra head, tenth head, missing head, flame breath, bright fantasy magic, humans, corpses, labels, text, watermark or border. Nine heads exactly.

Arrange the nine heads at separately spaced positions across the upper frame, like nine upright snake necks in a gently curved row: count 1,2,3,4 left of center, head 5 at center, heads 6,7,8,9 right of center. Every one has its own face and neck, clearly separated by empty background. Keep the body lower in the frame so there is generous room for all nine faces.
